about: Locations for facilities that EIA's API inventory (electricity/operating-generator-capacity) has no coordinates for. build_plants.py uses an entry only when the API has none. Plant IDs in the 88xx range are fuel terminals and gas-storage sites that report fuel stocks on Form EIA-923; they are not power plants, generate nothing, and carry a 'label' naming what they are. EIA often files them under the owning utility's state, so 'physical_state' records where they actually are. Entries with null coordinates could not be confirmed and stay off the map.
